### Hello my fellow Splinterlands Warriors,

Welcome back to another amazingly amazing Splinterlands post, and I hope all of you are doing pretty well in your lives and enjoying an awesome day with your family and friends. Now, if you are one of those undefeated souls who are actively engaging in this Web3 card-based strategy game, then I hope you are actively playing in this ongoing ranked season as well. If you look closely at the season timer, there are still 11 days and 2 hours left before this season ends, so the clock is ticking fast, and it is time to give our best in the remaining battles. Whether you are playing to reach a particular league tier or for a glorious seat on the top Champion leaderboard, I hope you reach there quicker this time.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPHndxVw1nQpWQjyJLw2qC36foKCxVjkfa34kCxDER5oy/screenshot_2026_10_20_at_5.07.03_pm.png)

Now, talking about me, I am currently playing in the highest Gold I league with 3,360 trophies, and my next target is to reach 4,000 trophies. There are still several days left in this season, so I will keep pushing forward and try my best to reach that goal. Let's see how far I can go this time! That was a little disappointing, but we all know how raffles work, so I will keep collecting entries and hope for better luck this week.

![Screenshot 2026-10-20 at 9.18.41 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23tGXnDoZVGppgWbCZuTsB6BhtbbuQC7MhVbHJst6njrJ28nEJ9iKSztqc2c79BfPYRGd.png)


 --- 


Now, talking about my daily activity, today marks my 157th consecutive streak day in the daily wheel. I received 150 Sparks along with another 38 bonus Sparks, which brings my total Sparks balance to 22,935. Keeping this streak alive feels great, and I will continue playing and collecting rewards as long as possible. Every little reward counts, especially when we are trying to make steady progress in the game.


 --- 




![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbJ9ZP3udpLACP4yDUPtCaUKfmKqnhC8temoPRMgkHjUT/screenshot_2026_10_20_at_1.38.28_pm.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ9Chhv45uPE3XK6JVgV9JYqHa7gzL5AnYRp2ktGgWmyL/screenshot_2026_10_20_at_1.39.38_pm.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYbindMNH4k7KRP6v5vEsUCqHjWYLMzkDLMmyodDJyxea/screenshot_2026_10_20_at_1.41.24_pm.png)


 --- 


I also opened 9 Foundation packs earned from the last three days of Frontier mission rewards. This time, the results were absolutely exciting! I got 2 Legendary cards, 1 Epic Gold Foil card, 2 more Epic cards, and 11 Rare cards, including 3 Archons. On top of that, I also received 1 Common Gold Foil card, while the remaining cards were regular Foil Commons. Getting two Legendary cards in a single opening is definitely a nice surprise, and this batch of packs has given me plenty of reasons to feel happy about the rewards. Let's hope the next opening brings even more good cards!

 --- 


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYi6qqFcSG7drtwRfWBcHTHYzUfLPDtxhuSRwfBFtPFtu/image.png)


 --- 


### Kaori Matsune

Now moving on to today's featured monster, let us take a closer look at another interesting monster from the newest Reward card set. As you have already seen in the title above, today we will be discussing Kaori Matsune, a Magic attacker with the Snipe ability. So, if you are interested in knowing more about this Neutral monster and its abilities, then let's take a deep dive without any further ado.

Kaori Matsune is a monster-type card that was first seen in the game with the launch of the latest Reward edition card set. This monster belongs to the Drakoshan bloodline and comes as a Legendary card. It costs only 5 Mana, so you can use it when playing low to medium mana limit matches. It uses Magic to attack its opponents. For a 5 mana card, its Mana cost is quite reasonable, especially when we consider its decent Speed, good Magic attack, and useful abilities. At its maximum level, this monster possesses 3 abilities, making it an interesting choice for players who want to target enemy support units and reduce the effectiveness of opposing Magic attackers. As a Legendary card, you will need 11 CC cards to upgrade Kaori Matsune to its maximum level. Let's now take a look at its stats and abilities at different league levels.

 --- 


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQv2Rd6u5xdH2z2G7nJYwS2jkzT7EzNJqzTMGe41jMuFE/screenshot_2026_10_20_at_1.56.53_pm.png)

 --- 



### BRONZE

At Level 1, Kaori Matsune possesses 2 Magic attack, 3 Speed, and 4 Health, along with the Snipe ability. Even at its starting level, it has a useful way to target enemies hiding behind the first position.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf7dYgdCRV7r8YudToyd1JKu45zxzfpUKPwPASg69PsZm/image.png)


`SNIPE` – Magic and Ranged units target the first non-Melee enemy unit behind the first position.

### SILVER

At Level 2, Kaori Matsune possesses 2 Magic attack, 3 Speed, and 4 Health and also gets a new ability.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVpQCa7muaKDgGdoGjfaebSgwH3mDidEm82kGeEdRP6m6/image.png)


`SILENCE` – Reduces the Magic attack of all enemy units by 1.

### GOLD

At Level 3, Kaori Matsune possesses 3 Magic attack, 3 Speed, and 5 Health. Its Magic attack increases to 3, while its Health also improves. This makes it a more powerful attacker without increasing its Mana cost.

### DIAMOND / CHAMPION

At Level 4, Kaori Matsune possesses 3 Magic attack, 3 Speed, and 6 Health. At its maximum level, this monster gains another defensive ability that helps protect it from certain negative effects.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZzaBxR5ZbhGwF4AXseNVXyetpLZGSsKmqpEvGVXN29Lh/image.png)


`IMMUNITY` – Provides immunity to Magic debuffs and Cripple.

### My Opinion About the Monster

In my opinion, Kaori Matsune is a very useful Magic attacker because it combines a useful attack, decent Speed, and a good Health pool for only 5 Mana. When we are building a team, Mana cost is always something we need to consider carefully. We cannot simply fill our lineup with expensive monsters and expect everything to work perfectly. That is why I like monsters that offer a good balance between their cost and the abilities they bring to battle, and Kaori Matsune certainly looks like one worth considering. Now, the first thing I like about this monster is its Snipe ability. With this ability, it can target the first non-Melee enemy unit behind that position. This can be very useful when the opponent has placed important support monsters, ranged attackers, or Magic attackers in the backline. The Silence ability is another amazing feature and a strong counter to Magic-based teams. It reduces the Magic attack of all enemy units by 1, which can make a significant difference when the opponent depends heavily on Magic damage. Instead of weakening just one target, this ability affects every enemy unit with Magic attack. Finally, the Immunity ability makes Kaori Matsune even more interesting at higher levels. It protects the monster from Magic debuffs and Cripple, helping it avoid those negative effects and remain useful for longer. This is particularly helpful when facing opponents who rely on debuffs to weaken our monsters during battle. Combined with its 6 Health at the maximum level, Immunity gives Kaori Matsune some extra staying power.

Overall, Kaori Matsune looks like a solid Legendary monster for players who enjoy strategic Magic-based battles. Snipe helps target important backline units, Silence weakens enemy Magic attackers, and Immunity protects against certain negative effects. Its 5 Mana cost also makes it easier to fit into a variety of lineups without using too much of the available Mana. If you are looking for a monster that can both attack strategically and support your team against Magic-heavy opponents, Kaori Matsune is definitely worth keeping an eye on!

### I hope you enjoyed reading my post about Kaori Matsune. Let me know your thoughts about today's post in the comments section below, and I look forward to seeing you all in my next post.

### Thanks for visiting my post, hope we meet again!

#### Stay well and keep playing Splinterlands!

<center>Yesterday, with the game update on [**2026-10-20**](https://docs.splinterlands.com/platform/release-notes/2026#id-2026-10-20), the **Splinterlands** team brought us another new Ruleset that can drastically alter the tempo and duration of battles, making them much more defensive. This new Ruleset is:</center>

><center>El día de ayer, con la actualización del [**2026-10-20**](https://docs.splinterlands.com/platform/release-notes/2026#id-2026-10-20), el equipo de **Splinterlands** nos trae otra nueva Ruleset que puede cambiar bastante el ritmo y la duración de las batallas haciéndolas más defensivas, y esa Ruleset nueva es:</center>

## <center>Equalized Armor</center>
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmNT9SH7qNRdG6ZeKF3s7DjANFELstRc3aa1GmdE2fpG76/img_combat-rule_equalized-armor_150.png</center>

- **Equalized Armor:** The Initial Armor of all Units is equal to that of the Unit on either team with the highest base Armor.

>- **Equalized Armor:** La armadura inicial de cada unidad es igual a la de la unidad de cualquiera de los dos equipos con la mayor armadura base.

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmY5KpTtvoAAcdA1MQGHRcntUSwoGjyyxXLCVtpYnLQ4wz/image.png</center>

<center>In simple terms, every unit's starting armor on the field will match the highest base armor value present among all fielded cards across both teams. While at first glance it appears to be the physical protection equivalent of the classic **Equalizer** a mechanic that traditionally equalizes health pools the arrival of **Equalized Armor** will make matches lean much more defensive in most cases, extending round counts and elevating the value of skills that previously saw situational usage.</center>

><center>En términos sencillos, la armadura inicial de cada unidad en el campo se igualará a la cantidad base de armadura que posea la carta con el valor más alto entre ambos equipos. Y aunque a primera vista parece ser la versión orientada a la protección física de la clásica **Equalizer** una mecánica que tradicionalmente empareja los puntos de salud con la llegada de **Equalized Armor** las batallas tomarán una tónica mucho más defensiva en la mayoría de los casos, extendiendo el número de rondas e impulsando el valor de habilidades que antes tenían un uso condicionado.</center>

### <center>Redefining unit value: The rise of support and high-armor tanks | Redefiniendo el valor de las unidades: El auge del soporte y tanques de alto blindaje</center>

<center>The immediate impact of this battle condition will be noticed during monster selection in the lineup phase. To maximize the benefit of **Equalized Armor**, it will become almost mandatory to include at least **1** unit with an extremely high base armor value, ensuring our entire team receives a colossal initial shield.</center>

><center>El impacto inmediato de esta condición de batalla se notará en la selección de monstruos durante la fase de alineación. Para sacar el máximo provecho de **Equalized Armor**, se volverá casi obligatorio incluir al menos **1** unidad que posea un valor de armadura extremadamente elevado, garantizando que todo nuestro equipo reciba un escudo inicial colosal.</center>

<center>In this scenario, low mana cost cards with massive armor transform into top-priority support engines. A perfect example is **Clockwork Aide**, a unit that, thanks to its high defensive ratio relative to its mana cost, can be deployed as a passive driver solely to inject that huge shield amount into all allied units. Likewise, cards with overwhelming natural armor will gain huge meta presence over options that, despite appearing stronger individually in attack power or speed, fail to provide that global defensive boost.</center>

><center>En este escenario, cartas de bajo costo de maná pero con blindaje masivo pasan a convertirse en piezas de soporte prioritarias. Un ejemplo perfecto de esto es **Clockwork Aide**, una unidad que, gracias a su alto valor defensivo en relación con su costo, puede ser desplegada como un motor pasivo únicamente para inyectar esa enorme cantidad de armadura a todo el equipo aliado. Asimismo, cartas con armaduras naturales abrumadoras ganarán muchísima presencia en el metajuego sobre otras opciones que, aunque individualmente puedan parecer más fuertes en ataque o velocidad, no aportan ese impulso defensivo global.</center>

### <center>The battle against the shield: Corrosive Ward, Rust, Piercing, and magic damage | La batalla contra el escudo: Corrosive Ward, Rust, Piercing y daño mágico</center>

<center>When facing battles where every opposing unit can start with **8**, **10**, or more armor points, relying exclusively on conventional physical damage becomes a headache. For this reason, **Equalized Armor** will force players to dust off and integrate defensive disruption tools on a massive scale.</center>

><center>Al enfrentarnos a batallas donde cada unidad en la alineación enemiga puede iniciar con **8**, **10** o más puntos de armadura, depender exclusivamente del daño físico convencional se convertirá en un dolor de cabeza. Por esta razón, **Equalized Armor** obligará a los jugadores a desempolvar e integrar masivamente herramientas de disrupción defensiva.</center>

<center>Abilities like **Rust** (to reduce enemy team armor), **Corrosive Ward**, and **Piercing** will see a drastic spike in usage. Meanwhile, fielding magic-based compositions will stand out as one of the most popular and efficient counters, since magic attacks completely bypass shields to strike enemy health bars directly.</center>

><center>Habilidades como **Rust** (para reducir la armadura global del rival), **Corrosive Ward** y **Piercing** verán un incremento drástico en su tasa de uso. Por su parte, la inclusión de alineaciones basadas en daño mágico será una de las respuestas más populares y eficientes, ya que el ataque mágico permite sobrepasar por completo el escudo para impactar directamente en la barra de salud de los enemigos.</center>

### <center>The decisive role of Shatter | El papel determinante de Shatter</center>

<center>Among the mechanical answers to counter this rule, units or Archons featuring **Shatter** will position themselves as true strategic gems. **Shatter** holds the power to instantly obliterate a target's entire armor pool upon landing a single hit, nullifying the rule's benefit on that unit in a single instant.</center>

><center>Dentro de las respuestas mecánicas para contrarrestar esta regla, las unidades u Archons que cuenten con la habilidad **Shatter** se posicionarán como verdaderas joyas de estrategia. **Shatter** posee la capacidad de destruir instantáneamente toda la armadura del objetivo tras asestar un solo golpe, anulando en un instante el beneficio que la regla le otorgó a esa unidad.</center>

<center>As a player who loves competing with **Immortalis**, this rule is immensely attractive and exciting. **Immortalis** is one of the few Archons granting **Shatter** to all allied units, dismantling colossal enemy defenses in early combat rounds while pairing it with magic damage reduction to neutralize opponents attempting to bypass armor through magic.</center>

><center>Como jugador al que le encanta competir con **Immortalis**, esta regla resulta sumamente atractiva y emocionante. **Immortalis** es uno de los pocos Archons que otorga la habilidad **Shatter** a sus unidades, lo que permite desarmar defensas enemigas colosales en las primeras rondas del combate, combinándolo además con su reducción de daño mágico para neutralizar a los rivales que intenten atacarnos por esa vía.</center>

### <center>Explosive combos with Armor Strike | Combos explosivos con Armor Strike</center>

<center>Another ability heavily impacted by this new condition is **Armor Strike**. This mechanic enables a unit to execute an extra attack whose power scales off the remaining armor it holds at that moment.</center>

><center>Otra de las habilidades que se verá fuertemente impactada por esta nueva condición es **Armor Strike**. Esta mecánica permite a una unidad ejecutar un ataque adicional cuyo poder depende de la cantidad de armadura que conserve en ese momento.</center>

<center>Under **Equalized Armor**, we will witness striking and chaotic battle moments: low-attack units receiving a massive starting armor boost can hit with devastating force through **Armor Strike**, taking down core tanks or key pieces in **1** hit like a nuclear bomb. These rare, unexpected synergies will generate highly enjoyable and memorable combat highlights.</center>

><center>Bajo la influencia de **Equalized Armor**, podremos presenciar momentos verdaderamente llamativos y caóticos en la batalla: unidades de bajo ataque que, al recibir un impulso de armadura descomunal al inicio de la partida, podrán golpear con una potencia devastadora a través de **Armor Strike**, siendo capaces de eliminar a tanques o unidades clave de un solo golpe como una bomba nuclear. Se crearán momentos sumamente divertidos y llamativos en las batallas gracias a estos combos raros e inesperados.</center>

### <center>Conclusion </center>

<center>In general terms, **Equalized Armor** may not be immediately labeled as one of the most flashy or chaotic Rulesets, as its primary effect in most matchups simply extends battle length by adding a couple of attrition rounds. However, in the hands of players who read synergies like **Shatter**, **Armor Strike**, or the smart use of Archons like **Immortalis**, this new condition turns into fertile ground for tactical calculations and highly destructive strategies.</center>

><center>En líneas generales, **Equalized Armor** tal vez no sea calificada de entrada como una de las Rulesets más vistosas o caóticas del juego, ya que su efecto primario en la mayoría de los enfrentamientos será simplemente extender la duración de la batalla sumando un par de rounds adicionales de desgaste. No obstante, en manos de jugadores que sepan leer las sinergias de habilidades como **Shatter**, **Armor Strike** o el uso inteligente de Archons como **Immortalis**, esta nueva condición se transformará en un terreno fértil para el cálculo táctico y la creación de estrategias altamente destructivas.</center>

I explain their abilities and all the details to make monster selection easier for you. When it is time for a battle you can easily select them and position them in the best way.

I will compare these two monsters to see which monster is more suitable to buy at its price, which one is more powerful and which one is better to add to your team. Today I will talk about Dargotham Garnet versus Doomshield Warden and explore their details to make it easier for you to choose the best one between these two.

First, let's talk about Dar 'Gottem' Gearnut which is a very heavy and powerful card. As I mentioned this is a high mana card so its mana cost is 14. By selecting it in a high mana battle and positioning it in the best way, you can achieve a good win in the battle.

<center>

---
# DAR GOTTEM GEARNUT
---

![Untitled design (6).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23y98nmWqMv5TB17W2pyFQecRt8jeb4xXerBgCQfisBkJqWz9xj21xxcshQ1h77TigtRp.png)

</center>

It is a melee attacker and its attack power is 3. This means it will keep attacking with 3 power in every round and continue to damage enemy units. It has 4 armor which protects its health. According to its mana cost this armor is not very good. However because attacks in high mana battles are very powerful, its armor might be destroyed in just one round. This is a very negative point for this monster.

But it has 25 health which is currently the highest health power in the entire market. This is considered its biggest quality. Even against strong attackers it can easily survive for four to five rounds. And during that much time the whole situation of any battle can change.

It has 3 speed which is not particularly special especially considering its mana cost. Speed increases its attack speed and also helps it make enemy attacks miss.

At its maximum level, it has four special abilities including Trample, Flank, Inspire and Void. These four abilities support its allied units, provide protection and also allow it to take an aggressive stance itself.

Let's learn about these abilities.

<center>

---

---

</center>

Trample: After performing a melee attack if the enemy unit is defeated, it performs another melee attack against the unit in the next position.

Similarly Flank works like this that at the beginning of the battle if you place this monster in the first position, the second melee attacker in the second position gets the Reach ability. The monster with Reach will also continue to perform melee attacks while remaining in the second position.

Inspire is its third ability. Its purpose is to give all allied units +1 melee power.

Void is its fourth ability. With this ability it continues to receive 50 percent less damage from any magic attacker.

<center>

---

![Screenshot 2026-10-20 101157.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/EopmeDpn8VV6kJSHgrcz6BvzaA18q1PAsKc9Zgrjowzb7GmexXRyjx9V8yQdJSGs2Rs.png)

It is quite an expensive card because it has some very good powers. And if I talk about its rental price it starts from 19 DEC and goes up to 300 DEC depending on its level.

Again, you should select this card in high mana battles to get benefits from it. In low mana battles it will be considered a waste so it is very important to be careful when selecting it for any mana battle.

It is a melee attacker with a melee attack power of 7. Compared to the previous card, this is much better because its attack power is more than double. So in every round it will continue to attack enemy units with 7 power and deal very heavy damage to them. This is its biggest quality compared to the other card.

If I talk about its armor it also has 9 armor which is more than double the armor power of the previous card. This is very good armor considering its mana cost and it provides protection for its life.

However it does not have as much health as compared to other card. Its health power is only 11 which determines how long it can stay alive. Again in a high mana battle if I combine its health and armor it can survive for four to five rounds making it almost equal to the other card in this regard.

<center>

![Untitled design.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/242s3pt7feppNLbgwmfj53T7FyimdFoMX5LsCdd1GRPRceM3eTu317eGVYNeur3hNjce8.png)

Void Armor is its third ability. With this ability, all magic damage will hit the armor first and then affect its health. Since its low health was a concern, this ability now makes it an excellent counter against magic attackers.

True Strike is its fourth special ability. With this ability its attacks will never miss and every attack will hit its target.

Only 4 days into the current season, I’ve already unlocked Modern Division 6. This didn’t happen by chance—I exhausted all my 'Modern' energy, and by last night, I was left with zero energy, waiting for it to refill so I could keep playing. Since it takes one hour for a single unit of energy to regenerate, even waiting an entire day would only yield 24 energy points. I was really itching to play, so I decided to wait a full day to accumulate enough energy for a decent session. After using all 50 energy points—and maintaining a win rate of over 70%—I’m now on the verge of moving past Division 6. Furthermore, the 'welcome loot' I received upon unlocking Division 6 is quite interesting; it includes 3,000 Glint, along with 4 Minor chests and 2 Major chests.

Aside from the 3,000 Glints, let’s look at the first 4 Minor Chests. From these, I received 256 Merits and 2 cards—one Common and one Rare. The Common card is an Earth-element magic attack card called "Stonebind Matron." With a mana cost of 8, it doesn't seem particularly powerful. In my deck, I’ve upgraded it to Level 4, which has increased its speed by 1 point and its health by 2 points; however, it still feels somewhat underwhelming, as it lacks any armor for extra protection. That said, I noticed that at Level 5, the card gains the "Triage" ability, which restores one-third of its maximum health every round—at that point, it will likely become one of my favorite cards.

Similarly, the Water-element melee attack card "Surgehammer" also starts with low health and no armor. In my deck, I have it upgraded to Level 3, where it gains +1 health and 1 point of armor, making it a bit stronger—plus, it has a lower mana cost. However, the most significant difference between the two lies in their attack power. This is crucial because, while melee attacks must get through armor to reach a target's health, magic attacks bypass armor entirely to strike health directly. Given the choice, I personally prefer magic attack cards over melee ones.

From two Major Chests, I received 436 Merits—a significantly better haul than what I typically get from Minor Chests. The second chest contained two copies of a common Fire-element card: 'Cullborn Revenant.' At Level 1, it possesses a magic attack but appears quite weak in terms of health. However, in my deck, I have upgraded this card to Level 4, granting it +2 Health and +1 Speed. Its final stats now include 2 Magic Attack, 1 Armor, 4 Health, and 3 Speed, along with the 'Snipe' ability—making it a noticeably better card than it was at Level 1. That said, I still only use it when absolutely necessary, though it performs reasonably well when deployed. Ultimately, a card's performance often depends on how effectively you integrate it into the right lineup.

* * *

Splinterlands isn't an easy place, but that's what makes it even more fun. A perfect strategy takes into account many factors, including stats, abilities, rulesets, mana caps, and more. That's why it's even more important to consider all these factors when developing a strategy. Add good cards to your deck, but also work on improving your strategies, and strive to win as many battles as possible!🔥

If you also want to enjoy this amazing game and you have not yet signed up, I invite you to Splinterlands, and I will also try my best to guide you in this game. 😎

Please don't think that anything I have written in this blog has been copied from somewhere or is AI-generated.` 2. `Paragraph Dividers and all the photos are from #Splinterlands.` 3. `All the other content images and words are mine unless otherwise stated.`

Have a Happy and Blessed day!

Todays 47 mana battle was very interesting and I got the opportunity to play this battle with three challenging rulesets where I faced a tough defeat in 3 rounds. The game ended very quickly because of the double damage ruleset and the enemy's unit combination and reverse speed strategy worked better on the battlefield.

In any high mana battle with multiple restrictions it is important that you first understand every ruleset properly and then select your team accordingly. If you do this your chances of winning will become much higher. 

When there are speed modifiers and attack type restrictions present every single pick matters a lot and one small mistake in card selection can cost you in the battle. That is why you need to have full focused when understanding the rulesets.


Before moving toward the battle breakdown and my strategy first lets understand the rulesets what is explained in these rulesets and what strategy and team combination I made according to them.

![Screenshot 2026-10-21 104200.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23uEz3UCpcf6JnfHoQXfcnmvr8XV6z9pXaph2A4t9TVQN8n8nYzvVkCu5MdCt2Zz23HjW.png)


# RULESET 1: FEROCITY

This is a ruleset where all units have Fury ability. And what does this Ferocity ruleset do? It deals double damage to any target that possesses the Taunt ability.

Because of this Ferocity ability relying on Taunt units becomes extremely risky because opposing attackers will strike them with double power.

According to this ruleset it is necessary to adopt a strategy where you avoid using Taunt cards or prepare heavy defense for the battle.

## RULESET 2: REVERSE SPEED

This is a ruleset where units with the lowest speed attack first and have the highest chance to evade attacks. 

And what does this Reverse Speed ruleset do? It completely flips the standard speed order making slower units act first on the turn order.

Normally it happens that higher speed will attach first but according to this ruleset the situation is reversed.


Because of this Reverse Speed ability bringing cards with high speed stat actually becomes a disadvantage because they will take their turns last.

According to this ruleset it is necessary to adopt a strategy where you pick slow heavy hitters with 1 or 2 speed so they can strike before the opponent.

## RULESET 3: BROKEN ARROWS

This is a ruleset where you cannot summon units with ranged attacks. And what does this Broken Arrows ruleset do? It disables all ranged damage dealers from being selected.

Because of this Broken Arrows ability both players are forced to rely purely on melee and magic units.

According to this ruleset it is necessary to adopt a strategy where you build a strong lineup around melee front liners and magic attackers.

![Screenshot 2026-10-21 104311.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23u5vMvh24tWcXauZUeA4kVhBzMxwfA1cPax1WcwjRDhMRRv11xzRMSBPazc1Y7Hkhi3J.png)


## MY STRATEGY AND MONSTERS SELECTION

Keeping these three rulesets in mind what strategy did I adopt and which units did I select? I knew that under Broken Arrows I needed a mix of melee and magic and under Reverse Speed I needed slow units.

First of all I selected my Archon Marlai Singariel which gives +1 magic to my allied units. In normal battles this speed boost is very good but under Reverse Speed granting extra speed accidentally made my units slower in turn order.

On the front line in first position I selected my main front tank with high health and armor to take heavy hits.

In the second position I selected my second melee unit with reach ability with 2 speed to provide early attacks.

In the third position I selected my third melee card to add extra physical attack power. And also that have magic attack power where it continues to attack being at 3rd position.

The 4th and 5th position monsters were the mix of magic attackers that will continue to perform +2 magic attacks every round.

In the sixth position I selected my backline support card which has return ability as well.


![Screenshot 2026-10-21 104440.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23tvkkQ6KuQLSVgutxpb1x9tYgAcuubj7afQTCHHtP977fyvJTxFYBcSqQdy2WKnDaMV2.png)

![Screenshot 2026-10-21 104416.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23tmKiezZjcS4fURfg4o3WQhj8jLpbaU4NYtn2SqwUDy4LivgwCAgFj4ECNJLcULKJJDn.png)

![Screenshot 2026-10-21 104410.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23u65Px5Wq2m2fZR59pXFZHGjjNgDuUB4eNwSEUE8tnNQeg6Ep42efqQH1imfwnnPu2dE.png)

![Screenshot 2026-10-21 104403.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23uQpSEJWcXxnGHZQcpuNr4V8TxBncDHWracu4pNwxGp6KD8imAJckiHKcjQstg7KFZCP.png)

## ON THE BATTLEFIELD

When I looked at the enemy lineup on the battlefield it was also quite interesting. They had brought a team that utilized slow units very well under Reverse Speed including a slow front tank with 2 speed.

The battle started with initial strikes coming from both sides. Heavy attacks continued till first round.

In Round 1 both sides traded hits. The enemy's slower units took advantage of Reverse Speed and attacked first taking down my front line defenses before my team could launch their full power.

In Round 2 the enemy pushed their advantage further. Their front line units dealt continuous damage and eliminated my main tank leaving my middle cards exposed.

In round 2, the battle was 5vs4 which was still interesting. But as round 3 started I realized that I have lost this battle.

In Round 3 the battle came to an end. My remaining magic unit tried to hold the position but the enemy's combined forces were too strong.

![Screenshot 2026-10-21 104346.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23tRvMsc64yrcsCsbS2EpdUBqwc87zx98vaFVUHyGg9BX2tZ1bd58HXssn558fhViK3qk.png)


At the end of Round 3 I faced a defeat. The main reason was that I didnot understand the rulesets properly and I had wrong monster selections in the end.


What would your strategy be in this type of ruleset and which units would you give more preference to? Will be glad to see your answers in the comment section.

I hope you find this post useful and informative.. If you do, please remember to reblog it so that it reaches as many people as possible and that they can benefit the most from it. Also remember to upvote which will help me financially and grow my account.

I have units for this Marlai archon that has magic power, increasing its magic power will have more chances on winning each game of this splinterlands.
